Co-ed pickleball tournament returning to Ocala courts

by Ocala EventsNovember 1, 2026October 29, 2026
💬 ⭐ Prefer on Google
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

The Ocala Parks and Recreation Department will host a Pickleball: King of the Court, coed doubles tournament this week.

Ocala news subscription

Registration is now open for the tournament, which takes place on Friday, November 6. The tournament will take place from 6:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. at the Jervey Gantt Recreation Complex Outdoor Pickleball Courts, located at 2200 SE 36th Avenue in Ocala.

The tournament features a coed doubles format with double-elimination play. The entry fee is $40 per team, and registration is open through the day of the event on November 6, 2026.

Interested participants can register or request more information by calling 352-401-3915 or visiting Ocala Recreation and Parks.
